title: Pather Panchali
subtitle: A Childhood Unfolds Amid Rural Bengal's Beauty
summary: Step into the vibrant heart of rural Bengal with Pather Panchali, where the joys and hardships of daily life are etched into every moment. Follow young Apu, his spirited sister Durga, and their resilient parents as they navigate the shifting fortunes and small wonders of their ancestral village. Through lush descriptions and heartfelt scenes—like a child's delight over a shared banana—the novel invites readers to experience the innocence, longing, and resilience that define family bonds. Bibhutibhushan Bandyopadhyay's masterpiece offers a poetic window into a vanishing world, alive with nature, tradition, and the bittersweet pulse of growing up.
